source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 3 June 1955, p. 7 ("Results in county and rural council contests"); Lisburn Herald, 11 June 1955, p. 2 ("Election notices: notice of result of elections, Hillsborough Rural District, dated 2 June 1955")
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: Votes as printed; 411-171=240. Names re-checked on the cited page BNL19550603.1.7 with a fresh fetch of the INA OCR: all surnames present (gap-fill 6 Nov 2026).

note: Triennial election of the sixteen district electoral divisions of Hillsborough rural district, one member each, polled Thursday 2 June 1955. Two contests, Carryduff and Ballymacbrennan; thirteen members returned unopposed; no nomination for Dromara, whose retiring member was deemed re-elected (returning officer's notice of result, Lisburn Herald, 11 June 1955, p. 2; round 2, 7 Nov 2026). The notice of result gives the loser as 'Bell, James Crothers' (171) and the winner as Thomas John Corry (411).
